text:
marie: Heads up—Marigold learned to ride my kid's mini scooter and now she thinks it's her lap. dropping pics. https://i.imgur.com/marigold-scooter.jpg :scooter::heart_eyes:
luke: NO WAY that's a scooter corgi. is that even legal? :laughing:
marie: she pushes with back legs and uses front paws to steer. posted a 0.8s slo-mo but it makes her look like an action hero.
tara: bring her to pet day? will she allow strangers to pet the scooter? :thinking:
marie: yes to pet day, she loves humans but only if you offer chicken jerky. also pls no small scooters with sharp edges.
design-bot: Idea: office sticker "Marigold: Queen of Scooters" :sparkles: vote +1/-1
luke: +1 for sticker. also, doggo safety PSA — secure little wheels and keep helmet optional.
marie: there's a tiny knit helmet she tolerates for 3.2 seconds. photo dump incoming, including a GIF of a dramatic skid.
hr-bot: Reminder: pets-in-office next Tue 11am-3pm. Bring proof of vaccinations and fill the short form in #people-ops. :clipboard:
tara: ooh I'll bring my rabbit. they can have a scooter race? :rabbit:
luke: please send the slo-mo gif when you upload
marie: uploaded in thread: scooter-gif.mp4 (link) https://i.imgur.com/marigold-scootergif.mp4
